title: Bayesian Nonparametric Mixed-Effect ODEs with Gaussian Processes
abstract: arXiv:2605.13088v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Dynamical modelling in pharmacometrics, systems biology, and epidemiology often involves subjects with related but distinct dynamics, observed through temporally sparse and irregular measurements. Classical nonlinear mixed-effects ODE models represent this heterogeneity but rely on parametric vector fields, making them vulnerable to structural misspecification. Existing nonparametric ODE methods typically assume shared dynamics rather than an explicit mixed-effect hierarchy. We propose MEGPODE, a Bayesian nonparametric mixed-effect ODE model that decomposes each subject's vector field into a shared population component and a subject-specific deviation, both endowed with Gaussian process priors. To avoid repeated ODE solves during training, we represent latent trajectories with state-space GP priors and penalize discrepancies between their derivatives and the vector fields on a finite time grid. translated_title: 基于高斯过程的贝叶斯非参数混合效应常微分方程模型
translated_abstract: 药物计量学、系统生物学和流行病学中的动力学建模通常涉及具有相关但又各不相同动力学的受试者，且观测数据在时间上稀疏且不规则。经典的非线性混合效应常微分方程（ODE）模型能够表示这种异质性，但依赖于参数化的向量场，因而容易受到结构性误设的影响。现有的非参数ODE方法通常假设动力学是共享的，而非显式的混合效应层次结构。我们提出了MEGPODE，这是一种贝叶斯非参数混合效应ODE模型，它将每个受试者的向量场分解为共享的种群成分和受试者特异的偏差，两者均赋予高斯过程先验。为避免训练过程中重复求解ODE，我们使用状态空间高斯过程先验来表示潜在轨迹，并在有限时间网格上惩罚其导数与向量场之间的差异。单一的变分目标使得（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出MEGPODE模型，利用高斯过程先验将每个受试者的ODE向量场分解为共享种群成分与个体偏差，并通过状态空间高斯过程和单一变分目标避免重复求解ODE，从而在稀疏不规则观测下实现灵活且稳健的非参数动力学建模。
en_tdlr: MEGPODE, a Bayesian nonparametric mixed-effect ODE model that decomposes each subject's vector field into shared population and subject-specific Gaussian process components, using state-space GP priors and a single variational objective to avoid repeated ODE solves, enabling flexible and robust dynamical modeling under sparse and irregular observations.
